back2basics.text: Suo motu PIL is a legal action initiated by a court on its own motion without a formal petition from an external party. It allows courts to address issues of public interest proactively, especially when fundamental rights or rule of law are at risk.

structure.intro: Advanced materials research is central to developing innovative solutions for energy and environmental challenges.

mcq.stem:
Consider the following statements about the iMEET-2026 conference:
1. It is hosted by CSIR-IICT at Tarnaka campus from November 4 to 6, 2026.
2. The conference focuses on advanced materials including rare earth elements, nanomaterials, and energy materials.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.trap: A trap could be confusing the host institute or the conference dates; both are correctly stated in statement 1.

body.label: Conference focus
body.text: iMEET-2026 will cover advances in rare earth and critical materials, magnetic and multifunctional materials, advanced ceramics, nanomaterials, energy materials, optoelectronic materials, advanced coatings, surface engineering, and materials for strategic, environmental, and defence applications.

body.label: Host and venue
body.text: The conference is hosted by CSIR-IICT at its Tarnaka campus in Hyderabad from November 4 to 6, 2026.

sections.heading: What is the iMEET-2026 conference about?

body.label: Distinguished speakers
body.text: The event features eminent experts including DRDO director-general (Naval Systems and Materials) R. Balamurali Krishnan, MIDHANI chairman and managing director S.V.S. Narayana Murty, and Sri Venkateswara University-Tirupati Vice-Chancellor T. Narasinga Rao.

sections.heading: Who are the key participants and speakers?

body.label: Relevance to science and technology
body.text: The summit showcases India's research in advanced materials crucial for energy transition and environmental sustainability, topics relevant to GS Paper 3 on science and technology and environment.

body.label: Link to energy transition
body.text: Materials discussed at iMEET-2026 support innovations in energy and environmental technologies, aligning with India's goals for sustainable development and strategic autonomy.

sections.heading: Why does this summit matter for UPSC aspirants?
